args.title: Late-Deploy Coverage Note
args.body:
The Q3 2022 weekend incident should have taught us that a small blast radius and lucky timing do not make a late deploy safe. The underlying risk was the same one that later surfaced in March: people were offline, rollback ownership was unclear, and response time stretched the impact.

We should have documented the lesson immediately: no production pushes after 3pm Friday unless the full on-call roster is online and ready to respond. The gate should block by default; exceptions require Morgan’s explicit approval. Writing that rule then could have prevented March’s late-deploy coverage problem from recurring.
